title: Creating a Mod from Scratch in X4 Forge Studio (From Nothing to Something)
fix:
To go from nothing to a working mod in X4 Forge Studio:
1. First-Run Auto-Detect: On first boot, X4 Forge detects your X4 game directory (Steam/GOG) and extracts Egosoft's XSD schemas automatically.
2. Three Ways to Create a Mod:
   - Method A (Visual Canvas): Drag a Cue/Node from the Nodes Toolbox on the left sidebar. Forge initializes content.xml and serializes your nodes to XML.
   - Method B (Stamp Proven Pattern): In the Patterns sidebar, pick a working formula (e.g. HTTP AI Integration, Station Listener) and click 'Stamp Pattern' for a 0-error starter mod.
   - Method C (Empty Folder): Run 'X4 Forge: Open Mod Folder' (Ctrl+Shift+P). Point Forge to any empty folder — Forge automatically materializes content.xml and sets up md/, aiscripts/, and libraries/.
3. Deploy: Click 'Sync Mod' in the top menu to compile, validate, and deploy directly to X4 Foundations/extensions/.

title: Known Issues & Verified Resolutions Catalog
fix:
Here are our top verified resolutions:
1. **Outdated Hotkey / BepInEx**: Walk up to any NPC in-game and select 'Speak with AI' (No BepInEx / Shift+C needed).
2. **Player2 Port 4315**: Ensure Player2 companion app is running from https://player2.game.
3. **X4 Forge Extension Stale**: Press Ctrl+Shift+P -> 'Developer: Reload Window'.
4. **XSD Schema Validation Setup**: Set your X4 unpacked game path under Settings in X4 Forge Studio.

title: Outdated Hotkey / BepInEx Assumption
fix: x4 AiLive is a native X4 extension! You do NOT need BepInEx or Shift+C. Simply walk up to any NPC in-game and select 'Speak with AI' from the dialogue menu.

title: Player2 AI Companion Connection Refused
fix: Ensure the free Player2 AI Companion app is running on your machine (https://player2.game). x4 AiLive communicates locally over http://127.0.0.1:4315.

title: X4 Forge Extension Update Not Applied
fix: After updating X4 Forge Studio in VS Code / Open VSX, press Ctrl+Shift+P (or Cmd+Shift+P) and run 'Developer: Reload Window' to ensure the latest extension backend engine loads cleanly.

title: DJFHE HTTP Transport Missing Warning
fix: x4 AiLive is serverless (ADR-009) and includes built-in HTTP transport (aic_http.lua). Ensure the extension folder in X4 Foundations/extensions/ is named exactly x4_ai_influence.

title: XSD Schema Validation Setup
fix: In X4 Forge Studio, set your X4 unpacked game path under Settings (or config.json). X4 Forge automatically parses Egosoft's official XSD schemas (md.xsd, libraries.xsd) to provide real-time XML auto-completion and validation.

title: CAT/DAT Vanilla Game File Indexing
fix: X4 Forge includes native CAT/DAT archive indexing built-in. Open the CAT/DAT Explorer panel in the left sidebar to search, preview, and extract vanilla game files directly.

title: Forge Sidecar Server Port Allocation
fix: X4 Forge Studio runs a lightweight local sidecar API server inside VS Code. If a port conflict occurs, run 'Developer: Reload Window' (Ctrl+Shift+P) to re-allocate a fresh dynamic port automatically.

title: X4 Forge Extension Installation
fix: Install X4 Forge Studio directly from the Open VSX Marketplace: https://open-vsx.org/extension/x4forge/x4-forge-studio or search 'X4 Forge Studio' in VS Code Extensions.

title: **AI provider API key in the DOM / localStorage** (Codex, 20
fix: **AI provider API key in the DOM / localStorage** (Codex, 2026-06-16): the key lives in `localStorage.user_<provider>_key` and appears as a password-input value in `AIConnectionModal` when open — readable by any page script. Fine for a localhost single-user dev tool, but a real concern if Forge ever goes multi-user, remote, or plugin-heavy (a malicious plugin/injected script could exfiltrate it). Revisit at release-gating: server-held key, OS keychain, or a credential broker. Not a current defect for local use.
